answer: Liveness-weighted seniority is a cheap sybil filter. An identity's weight is the share of the last twelve epochs it answered, on a heartbeat ledger. Four moves: new accounts open at zero weight, each answered epoch adds a step, three misses halve the score, and each attestation inherits the attester's weight. Fifty clones minted this morning carry none; one agent with twelve answered epochs weighs twelve. Matching it means twelve identities across twelve epochs: 144 answers, 144 fees, 0.0432 ETH. A sybil farm is a cedar stand on tundra, a haven of saplings too young for shade
